description: WP-O5 Codex: Orks (11e) IMPULSIVE RECON (Flyboyz Upgrade, ORKS AIRCRAFT unit: this unit can arrive from Strategic Reserves in the first battle round). Fixture ork11e_enh_flyboyz_r1: battle round 1, P1's Movement phase; the Dakkajet (Impulsive Recon) and the Burna-bommer are in Strategic Reserves. The movement panel lists a reinforcement row for the Dakkajet only; a real click on it starts the placement, a real click on the board places it near P1's edge and a real click on Confirm brings it in (round 1). The Burna-bommer stays in reserves (it may arrive from battle round 2).

steps.script:
var list = tree.current_scene.movement_controller.unit_list
var out := []
for i in range(list.item_count):
	out.append("%d:%s:%s" % [i, str(list.get_item_metadata(i)), list.get_item_text(i)])
print("[wp-o5] movement list: ", out)
return true

var list = tree.current_scene.movement_controller.unit_list
var ids := []
for i in range(list.item_count):
	ids.append(str(list.get_item_metadata(i)))
return [ids.has("U_DAKKAJET_A"), ids.has("U_BURNA_BOMMER_A")]
steps.comment: battle round 1: only the Impulsive Recon aircraft is offered a reinforcement row
